lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized in vertical columns on the flank posterior to the gill slits. A primary column contains three distinct centroids, followed by a secondary column of two centroids, forming a repeating 2D geometric grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity serve as axes that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a lattice of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear ridge feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, originating above the gill region and extending posteriorly, defined by a sharp vertical gradient of high-intensity luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small, dark-colored elongated shapes consistent with commensal fish swimming ventrally and posterior to the left pectoral fin.
